user.title: Set up Familienaufgaben
user.description: Shared to-do and appointment list for the whole family. Data is stored in /config/familienaufgaben/aufgaben.json – existing tasks there (e.g. from the former Pyscript version) are kept. Afterwards there is an "Aufgaben" entry in the sidebar and a "Familienaufgaben" card for your own dashboards.

error.pyscript_aktiv: The Pyscript version (pyscript/familienaufgaben.py) is still running. Remove or rename that file first, otherwise both write to the same data.

data_description.seitenleiste: Shows the task list as its own page in the sidebar (for all users).
data_description.link: Path opened when a notification is tapped, e.g. /familienaufgaben (sidebar) or /my-dashboard/tasks if the card is on your own dashboard.

liste.name: List
liste.description: Returns all tasks, the settings and who the caller is (used by the card).

speichern.name: Save task
speichern.description: Creates a task (without ID) or changes it (with ID). Pass the fields as "aufgabe" (object) or one by one. Persons as person.xyz, others just by name.

aufgabe.name: Task
aufgabe.description: Whole task as an object (this is what the card uses).

id.name: ID
id.description: ID of an existing task to change.

kategorie.name: Category
kategorie.description: Category ID, e.g. haushalt, auto, freizeit.

melden_an.name: Notify on execution
melden_an.description: Who gets a message when the task is done or started, e.g. [person.lena, "Grandma"]. External people via WhatsApp or e-mail if stored.

akteur.name: Who
akteur.description: Who does this (person.xyz); otherwise the logged-in user.

aktion.name: Action
aktion.description: Take over, hand back, plan, start, complete, reopen, set status or skip a recurring date.

akteur.name: Who
akteur.description: Who does this (person.xyz); otherwise the logged-in user.

loeschen.name: Delete task
loeschen.description: Deletes a task (ends a series). It goes to the trash and can be restored.

wiederherstellen.name: Restore deleted task
wiederherstellen.description: Brings a deleted task back from the trash.

einstellungen.name: Settings
einstellungen.description: Change categories, external persons, notifications, reminders, contacts, default view and retention.

ich_bin.name: Who am I?
ich_bin.description: Links the logged-in user to a person (for users without a linked person).

erinnern.name: Send reminder
erinnern.description: Sends every person what is due today or overdue. With dry run only shows it.

test.name: Test message
test.description: Sends a test message to a person via app, WhatsApp and e-mail (as far as set up).

person.name: Person
person.description: person.xyz or the name of another person.

email_dienst.name: E-mail service
email_dienst.description: notify service for e-mail; leave empty = configured service.
